name: Black-Box Electron Release E2E Matrix
purpose: Drive the built Electron app from outside the renderer so release readiness is based on real clicks, real window sizes, real dialogs, and real webview geometry instead of renderer-only synthetic element.click coverage.

windowProfiles.reason: Common laptop size that catches restored-window and profile dialog regressions.

assertions: renderer shell ready marker appears
active webview mounts
stage and active webview bounds stay aligned
guest DOM becomes ready
guest document bottom fills the viewport budget
Launchpad click routes the active tab
Guide click routes the active tab
Address bar Enter navigation works
Back, Forward, Reload, and Home are clickable
DevOps opens and closes
IT Tools opens and closes
Ops Panel opens and closes
Settings opens and closes
Profile dialog opens and closes in restored windows
Ctrl+K opens and Escape closes the Command Palette
Browser Kit opens and closes
Find bar opens from Browser Kit and closes cleanly
Normal browsing leaves the guest webview clickable inside the stage
Duplicate Active Tab works from Browser Kit
Reopen Closed recovers the latest tab in the active profile
Recent pages and recently closed lists populate
Restore Session remains available from built app state
Pin Active Tab keeps the tab at the front of the strip
Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab switch through visible tabs
Ctrl+1 focuses the first visible tab
Mission Control opens
Local mission creation works
Active tab can be added
Quad and Focus layouts remain selectable
Pin Active Pane populates export preview
Closing Mission Control restores normal browsing

securityTruth: no fake Store or GA approval claim
